name: What should I prepare before an on-site storm damage repair estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an on-site storm damage repair estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling your storm repair estimate, write down a timeline of when the storm occurred and compile photos of the initial damage and any temporary tarping. Locate your homeowners insurance policy information and mark every room where water or wind intrusion occurred, including attics, ceilings, and baseboards. Having these details ready helps your contractor inspect structural framing, insulation, and finish surfaces accurately, ensuring the initial repair scope accounts for all concealed drywall and trim damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather storm photos, note the exact event date, assemble insurance details, and list all affected rooms, ceilings, and trim areas for the contractor to inspect.
